subject: Re: Payee & Mailing Address Update — invoicing headers and VAT nomination after Everco acquisition
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@everco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@everco.com, m.bianchi@everco.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Payee & mailing address for invoicing after acquisition

Hi Mina —

Quick one as we tidy up post-close items for Everco’s recent acquisition of Northwood Transport. Our treasury team is consolidating payables and needs Redwood to update the invoicing payee and the remit address on all invoices going forward. The new remit details and VAT posture are attached (Everco_New_Invoicing_Instructions.xlsx).

Key asks:
- Can Redwood re-issue the outstanding July/August invoices to the consolidated group name (Everco Logistics S.p.A.) and new VAT number?
- Can future invoices use the new mailing address and the bank beneficiary mapping in the attached?
- Any implications for the invoice stamp or header we should be aware of for Italian VAT reporting?

We'd like to target switching from next billing cycle (invoices issued 2026-10-01) and also confirm whether Redwood needs a signed change-of-payee PO or any legal endorsement. Marco (copied) can sign where required.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Operations — Everco Logistics

Attachments: Everco_New_Invoicing_Instructions.xlsx, Everco-VAT-Certificate-2026.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@everco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 08:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payee & mailing address for invoicing after acquisition

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Congrats on the close. 

High level: we can update invoice headers and remit instructions, and re-issue prior invoices where there is explicit customer request and a signed PO or authorization. For VAT registration changes (Italy), we have an internal checklist before reissuing to ensure tax reporting alignment.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- Aditya (billing lead) and Jonas (treasury) will review the banking/beneficiary mapping and confirm wire routing changes.
- Please provide a signed change-of-payee PO (or a DocuSign link) authorizing reissuance of historical invoices to "Everco Logistics S.p.A."; Marco copying in legal is fine.
- Can you confirm which invoices (by invoice number) you want reissued? If it's July/August, list them and attach the signed PO and VAT certificate.

I've looped in Aditya, Jonas and Laura for the operational steps. We'll aim to have a confirmed plan and timeline by Tuesday.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

On a process note: reissuing invoices will create accounting adjustments; we normally flag them in our AR system and provide a consolidated reissue pack (redwood_reissues_YYYYMMDD.zip) — let us know if Everco needs GL account mapping included.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@everco.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:21:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Payee & mailing address for invoicing after acquisition

Elena / Mina —

Quick operational note from billing/treasury: we can process the header change and bank mapping, but we require the following to proceed with reissuing older invoices:
1) Signed Change-of-Payee PO or a legal directive on company letterhead (DocuSign accepted).
2) Copy of the VAT registration showing the new VAT ID for Everco Logistics S.p.A. (we received Everco-VAT-Certificate-2026.pdf — thank you).
3) List of invoice numbers to reissue and the preferred invoice date for the replacement documents.

Estimated timeline: once we have #1–#3, our billing queue can prepare reissued invoices within 3 business days. We'll then run an AR adjustment; if there are any outstanding payments already processed to the old payee, treasury will coordinate returns/re-credits with the bank — that may add 7–10 business days depending on clearing.

A couple of technical points to avoid delays:
- If the new remit beneficiary name differs materially (legal entity vs trading name), we will update the "Payee" field and produce a Payee Change Memo for your records.
- For Italian VAT stamping: we typically include the VAT ID on the invoice header; if Everco requires any specific wording on the invoice for Italian authorities, please flag it and we can include a custom footer.

Please drop the signed PO to this thread or send via DocuSign link. Once we have the signed PO I'll trigger the reissue batch.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Billing & Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Signed-PO-8721.pdf (if provided)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@everco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@everco.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 15:47:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Payee & mailing address for invoicing after acquisition

Aditya / Mina —

Thanks — attached are: the signed change-of-payee (Signed-PO-8721.pdf) and a PDF copy of the VAT certificate. We want July invoice #RWD-2026-07-114 and August invoice #RWD-2026-08-032 reissued to "Everco Logistics S.p.A." with new VAT ID IT12345678901 and remit address: Via Rogoredo 14, 20134 Milano, Italy.

We also included a note asking that Redwood add the wording "Per art. 23-ter, inversione contabile non applicabile" in the invoice footer to reflect the VAT treatment discussed with our tax counsel. Marco has approved the PO.

Link to signed DocuSign pack: https://app.docusign.com/some-docusign-id-8721

Please confirm timeline for issuance and whether Redwood needs any additional bank beneficiary forms.

Elena
